_comment: Moon and Mars upper-regolith constants for the Construction panel. Values are standard literature figures; 'verified': false means the team has not re-checked them against the original source, and the panel says so. They are context on the card, not scored.

bulk_density_g_cm3.depth_note: top ~15 cm; density increases with depth
bulk_density_g_cm3.citation: Carrier, Olhoeft & Mendell 1991, Lunar Sourcebook ch. 9 (physical properties of the lunar surface): ~1.50 g/cm3 in the top 15 cm, rising with depth

regolith_thickness_m.citation: Carrier, Olhoeft & Mendell 1991, Lunar Sourcebook ch. 9 (physical properties of the lunar surface): typically 4-5 m on maria, 10-15 m on highlands

cohesion_kpa.citation: Carrier, Olhoeft & Mendell 1991, Lunar Sourcebook ch. 9 (physical properties of the lunar surface)

friction_angle_deg.citation: Carrier, Olhoeft & Mendell 1991, Lunar Sourcebook ch. 9 (physical properties of the lunar surface)

bulk_density_g_cm3.depth_note: drift and crust-cloddy soils vary widely by site
bulk_density_g_cm3.citation: MER, Phoenix and InSight soil-mechanics results (e.g. Sullivan et al. 2011; Golombek et al. 2020) - to re-check

regolith_thickness_m.citation: MER, Phoenix and InSight soil-mechanics results (e.g. Sullivan et al. 2011; Golombek et al. 2020) - to re-check

cohesion_kpa.citation: MER, Phoenix and InSight soil-mechanics results (e.g. Sullivan et al. 2011; Golombek et al. 2020) - to re-check

friction_angle_deg.citation: MER, Phoenix and InSight soil-mechanics results (e.g. Sullivan et al. 2011; Golombek et al. 2020) - to re-check

usage.bulk_density: Michal copies the 'typical' value into the bulk_density feature of each target in targets.json.
usage.others: Shown on the construction panel as context, not scored.
